projectContext.authority: resolver-validated requester and explicit project grant; IDs are not grants

sourceEvent.note: Source cursors independent; gap requires authorized reconciliation

relation.rule: authorize endpoints, relation and labels before including; no hidden counts

command.note: Server validates grants; arbitrary requesterRef/grantRef values never confer authority; immutable registered specs

commandReceipt.note: accepted is durable admission, never proof of execution; terminal receipt follows executor evidence

fieldRules.jobRef: Absent or null until job assignment; required once accepted against an assigned job and for job terminal receipts.
fieldRules.observedRevision: Absent or null when admission cannot disclose an authorized revision.

versioning: Additive versioned Visualization spec; old readers get supported list/basic-network fallback. New focus acceptance requires actual upgraded renderer.

sourceSnapshot.note: Snapshot from one admitted source; unrelated sources need independent revisions/cursors. Not a claim that existing source APIs already use this envelope.

executionCommand.note: The Workbench adapter carries verified requester/project admission into the daemon. Local policy is independently validated again before side effects; user supplied references alone are never authorization.

jobEvent.note: Daemon execution observation, projected into projectionEvent only after scope checks. Cancel requested is not cancelled.
